dogecoin.text: As a crypto investment there are many many other coins I would personally put my money in & do not hold @Dogecoin this is not financial advice but this should be a very boring coin and I know we all want to make money not just hold onto something boring.

My thoughts on @dogecoin I believe it's biggest advantage will be price stability, I do not believe this is a big money making coin but it might be a coin used as a holding spot when in between coins.  It has an unlimited circulation which makes it similar to fiat.
